subtitle: Our Methodology
title: The Pathway
paragraph: A proven six-phase approach that guides organizations from initial assessment through to sustainable implementation.

cards.title: Diagnose
cards.text: Deep-dive analysis of current state, challenges, and opportunities across the organization.
cards.paragraph: We begin with a thorough understanding of your current landscape.

cards.title: Prioritise
cards.text: Identify and rank initiatives based on impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment.
cards.paragraph: Focus resources on what matters most.

cards.title: Co-Design
cards.text: Collaborate with stakeholders to design solutions that work for everyone involved.
cards.paragraph: Solutions designed with people, not for them.

cards.title: Test
cards.text: Validate approaches through pilot programs and structured feedback collection.
cards.paragraph: Learn fast, iterate quickly, scale confidently.

cards.title: Implement
cards.text: Roll out solutions with full support, training, and change management.

cards.title: Institutionalise
cards.text: Embed new practices into organizational culture for lasting impact.
